description.text: Magister Adler works through precedent at the lectern, testing each claim against the next.
Doctor Fenn guides the class to reach for the ambient flow; you find it at once and spend the hour refining rather than searching.
Doctor Fenn guides the class to reach for the ambient flow; you catch its edge and lose it, over and over, learning a little from each near-miss.
Doctor Fenn speaks of 'feeling the flow' and you feel nothing at all — only the cold of the hall. You copy the motions and hope the sense comes later.

name: Curfew
description: Return to the dormitories and sleep to restore your energy.
